versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G – Operating Limitations and Information
versions.text: The kinds of operation (such as flight rules, day or night) and the meteorological conditions (such as icing) to which the operation of the UAV System is limited or from which it is prohibited, must be established appropriate to the installed equipment.
